_about: Specs for scripts/world/hero_building.py: one entry per JindalX option. 'known' lists what the client's workbook (jindalx/source-options.json) or a public filing says; 'assumed' lists design choices made because the real design has not been seen. Replace an assumption as soon as the developer's drawings or photos arrive.
